root_cause.text: The nft_bitwise shift operation in netfilter uses `BITS_PER_TYPE(u32) - shift` to compute the carry from an adjacent 32-bit word, and a zero shift operand makes this expression equal to 32, causing undefined behavior because shifting a 32-bit type by 32 bits is undefined in C.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The carry propagation logic computes the carry from the adjacent 32-bit word using BITS_PER_TYPE(u32) - shift. A zero shift operand turns this into a 32-bit shift, which is undefined behaviour." The patch adds a check `if (!priv->data.data[0] || priv->data.data[0] >= BITS_PER_TYPE(u32))` to reject zero shift operands during initialization.
